question.text: A Cat III AIF taking a significant stake in a company undergoing NCLT proceedings, with an expectation of acquisition by a larger peer, is pursuing which strategy?

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 10.1.4.1 explicitly labels this 'Special Situations Strategy' or Activist Strategy — a sub-type of event-driven where the Cat III AIF looks to benefit from bankruptcy/restructuring/acquisition events. The Trap: Others don't match the NCLT/event trigger. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-D Cat I/II distressed PE is parallel but longer horizon. Manager's Pro-Tip: NCLT-special-situations have unpredictable timelines (often 2-3 years). Size small (<3% of NAV per case) and disclose expected holding period in PPM. Mark-to-market requires valuer sign-off; don't take aggressive interim marks.
